candidates.label: served_v17
candidates.note: Verbatim decision_review object extracted from the arm's raw model text (json_text).

output.narrative_summary: This result rests on the link from Competitive Intensity to Revenue Growth. If competition intensifies meaningfully, more runs could support a different option. In this model, 72% of runs supported Enter European Market.

story_headlines.opt_expand: Enter European Market builds on Europe Market Entry translating into revenue growth across most modelled runs.
story_headlines.opt_wait: Delay to Next Year would need competitive intensity to rise substantially for more runs to support it.

robustness_explanation.summary: The ordering holds in about 91% of variations, based on current estimates.
robustness_explanation.primary_risk: The link from Competitive Intensity to Revenue Growth is the main source of fragility here.
stability_factors: Europe Market Entry translating into Revenue Growth
fragility_factors: The link from Competitive Intensity to Revenue Growth could shift the comparison

output.readiness_rationale: The comparison is settled on your numbers: Europe Market Entry and Pricing Power both support the result, with only competitive intensity left open to check.

fac_competition.specific_action: Commission a short competitive landscape scan of European providers targeting your pro customer segment.
fac_competition.rationale: Competitive Intensity is the one factor with room to shift this comparison.
fac_competition.decision_hygiene: Estimate the likely competitive intensity before reviewing the scan.

edge_competition_revenue.trigger_description: If Competitive Intensity rises substantially along the link to Revenue Growth...
edge_competition_revenue.consequence: ...then the most runs would support Delay to Next Year rather than Enter European Market.

flip_thresholds.narrative: If Competitive Intensity moves from 35% to 62%, more runs would support a different option.

key_assumptions: The link from Europe Market Entry to Revenue Growth assumes current market conditions hold.
The brief's goal of reaching eight hundred pro customers assumes demand growth continues at a similar pace to today.
The link from Pricing Power to Revenue Growth assumes pricing power is maintained after entry.

decision_quality_prompts.question: What would make you switch to Delay to Next Year?
decision_quality_prompts.applies_because: Enter European Market is well supported on your numbers, so it is worth naming what would overturn that.

decision_quality_prompts.question: This failed because competitive intensity rose faster than modelled, what signs would show that early?
decision_quality_prompts.applies_because: The comparison is settled enough to act on, but the competitive intensity link is the one open fragility worth rehearsing.

pre_mortem.failure_scenario: Enter European Market failed because Competitive Intensity rose well beyond modelled levels, eroding the Pricing Power that supported Revenue Growth.
warning_signs: New entrants undercutting on price in the target European region
Early European pro customers churning faster than domestic ones
pre_mortem.mitigation: Run the competitive landscape scan before committing further spend to entry.
pre_mortem.review_trigger: Reconvene if early competitive signals look stronger than modelled, before scaling the entry.
